pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD. Tax: not stated. Extra GPU time can be bought at $4 per hour. Companies with more than $1,000,000 USD in annual gross revenue must subscribe to Pro or Mega (official plan comparison).
notes: Midjourney's own documentation lists no free plan; all plans are paid subscriptions that renew monthly or yearly. A 20% discount applies to annual plans.

profile.headline: Image generation from a prompt, with controls for style and detail

capabilities.title: Generate images from a text prompt
capabilities.text: Type your prompt in the Imagine bar, on the Midjourney website or in Discord.

capabilities.title: Choose the model version
capabilities.text: Add a version parameter to a prompt, or set a default version in the settings panel; each version handles prompts and styles differently.

capabilities.title: Get higher-resolution images
capabilities.text: HD images produce 2K results without upscaling, using more GPU time than standard images.

capabilities.title: Edit and extend images
capabilities.text: The Edit Model, along with pan, zoom out and vary-region tools, changes or extends an existing image.

featureCards.name: Personalization
featureCards.text: Learns your aesthetic tastes so results can match your style.

featureCards.name: Moodboards
featureCards.text: Listed as a supported feature in the documentation's feature chart.

featureCards.name: Style and image references
featureCards.text: Style Reference, Style Reference Codes and image prompts guide a result with an example.

featureCards.name: Raw mode
featureCards.text: Turn on Raw to remove default styling for closer prompt adherence.

featureCards.name: Niji models
featureCards.text: A series developed with Spellbrush that focuses on anime, Eastern aesthetics and illustrative styles.

featureCards.name: Speed modes
featureCards.text: Relax, Fast and Turbo modes are listed in the documentation's feature chart.

audienceDetail.text: The Niji models focus on anime and illustrative styles.

audienceDetail.who: People who want a consistent look
audienceDetail.text: Personalization, Moodboards and style references help repeat an aesthetic.
Prompts can be run in Discord as well as on the website.

scenarios.title: Explore visual ideas from a sentence
scenarios.text: Describe a scene and compare what different versions produce.

scenarios.title: Make repeatable characters in an anime style
scenarios.text: The Niji documentation says a newer Niji version follows prompts more closely for specific designs or repeatable characters.

scenarios.title: Produce higher-resolution images directly
scenarios.text: Turn on HD to generate 2K images without a separate upscale step.

scenarios.title: Adjust part of an image
scenarios.text: Use the Edit Model to change or extend an image you already made.

gettingStarted.text: Create an account on midjourney.com; the site offers Sign up and Log in.
Type it in the Imagine bar on the website or in Discord.
Add a version parameter to your prompt, or choose a default in the settings panel.
Switch on HD images in the settings panel or with the HD parameter.
